summary.text: Republican Jim Schwartzel won the open seat for Florida's 19th District on November 3, 2026, defeating Victor Arias, according to unofficial results.
A Southwest Florida broadcaster and publisher, he owns and operates conservative radio stations and a local newspaper publisher, and won the Republican primary on August 18, 2026.
In his Candidate Connection survey he describes himself as a businessman and outsider and says he ran to support President Trump's agenda.

paragraphs.text: Schwartzel was born in Naples, Florida, according to Ballotpedia, and describes himself as a lifelong Southwest Florida resident.
He graduated from Bishop Verot High School in Fort Myers and earned a bachelor's degree from Stetson University in 1998.
He says his first job, at age 12, was watering and sweeping the clay tennis courts at The Landings in Fort Myers.

Ballotpedia lists his career experience as business owner and president; according to The Floridian, he owns and operates 92.5 FOX News and Trump County 93.7 Radio in Southwest Florida and owns Gulfshore Life Media, which publishes the Naples Press.
Schwartzel announced his candidacy in April 2025, after Rep. Byron Donalds said he would not seek re-election and would run for governor.
He described himself to reporters as a non-politician and said he would buy his own ads on his stations rather than block other candidates' ads.
He won the August 18, 2026 Republican primary in a field of ten candidates with 29.1% of the vote.
He won the November 3, 2026 general election with 61.1% of the vote to Victor Arias's 37.6%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
According to his campaign survey, he is married to Carly and they have two children.
